title: WGCNA combined with machine learning identifies histone deacetylation-related diagnostic features for pediatric septic shock.
authors: Yao, Ji; Lai, Zhongbin; Yu, Di; Xia, Jingzhao; Huang, Qun; He, Shaoyi
journal: The Korean journal of physiology & pharmacology : official journal of the Korean Physiological Society and the Korean Society of Pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究用WGCNA和机器学习筛选儿童脓毒性休克组蛋白去乙酰化相关诊断基因，虽涉及转录因子预测但核心是表达诊断标志物，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Pediatric septic shock is a severe form of sepsis with high mortality. Histone deacetylation is involved in sepsis-related disorders. This study investigated the diagnostic value of histone deacetylation-related genes in pediatric septic shock. Three Gene Expression Omnibus datasets (GSE26378, GSE26440, and GSE13904) were analyzed. Differentially expressed genes from GSE26378 and GSE26440 were intersected with genes in key modules identified by weighted gene co-expression network analysis. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression and random forest were used to identify hub genes, and receiver operating characteristic curves assessed diagnostic performance. Quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction validated candidate gene expression. Immunoprecipitation preliminarily evaluated protein acetylation changes after trichostatin A treatment. Immune infiltration was analyzed, and related transcription factors and miRNAs were predicted. C9orf84, ASAP1-IT1, and CREB5 were identified as hub genes. All were upregulated in pediatric septic shock and showed favorable diagnostic performance in the training and validation datasets. Trichostatin A increased the acetylation levels and reduced the protein levels of C9orf84 and CREB5. Neutrophils, macrophages, and regulatory T cells were more abundant in pediatric septic shock than in controls. Multiple potentially interacting transcription factors and miRNAs were also identified. C9orf84, ASAP1-IT1, and CREB5 may serve as diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets for pediatric septic shock.
abstract_zh: 儿童脓毒性休克是脓毒症的一种严重形式，死亡率高。组蛋白去乙酰化与脓毒症相关疾病有关。本研究探讨了组蛋白去乙酰化相关基因在儿童脓毒性休克中的诊断价值。分析了三个基因表达综合数据库数据集（GSE26378、GSE26440和GSE13904）。将GSE26378和GSE26440中的差异表达基因与加权基因共表达网络分析识别的关键模块中的基因取交集。使用最小绝对收缩和选择算子回归及随机森林识别核心基因，并通过受试者工作特征曲线评估诊断性能。定量实时聚合酶链反应验证了候选基因的表达。免疫沉淀初步评估了曲古抑菌素A处理后蛋白质乙酰化变化。分析了免疫浸润，并预测了相关转录因子和miRNA。C9orf84、ASAP1-IT1和CREB5被识别为核心基因。这些基因在儿童脓毒性休克中均上调，并在训练和验证数据集中显示出良好的诊断性能。曲古抑菌素A增加了C9orf84和CREB5的乙酰化水平并降低了其蛋白水平。儿童脓毒性休克中的中性粒细胞、巨噬细胞和调节性T细胞比对照组更丰富。还识别了多个潜在相互作用的转录因子和miRNA。C9orf84、ASAP1-IT1和CREB5可能作为儿童脓毒性休克的诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点。
